svg.title: The Gate: the Book-Keeper's rules decide each proposed action
svg.desc: A supplier invoice arrives; the Book-Keeper's proposer, a model, proposes one action; the Gate matches it against the Book-Keeper's rules. Three possible proposals are shown. Record a bill: an allow rule, so it is performed at most once. Pay a bill: a hold rule, so an approval is queued for the Operator. Delete a bill: no rule matches it, so it is refused and recorded. Arrows show who calls whom.
